verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo top-left and badge top-right as in the original, but the subtitle is jammed under the headline and the shoe hangs off the clipped circle instead of sitting on it. B has the same detached shoe/circle problem, and it also swaps the brand: the badge crowds the top-left above the headline and the tiny SOLSTICE wordmark is pushed to the right, cut off from its sun icon.

A has the wordmark separated from its icon, the badge crowding the headline, and the shoe floating off the circle. B's headline hierarchy is stronger, but the shoe has shrunk to a trivial sliver perched on a circle cropped at the bottom, and the subtitle runs almost into the circle.

A has the same flaws as before: wordmark split from its icon, badge crowding the headline, shoe detached from the circle. B has a clear collision: the subtitle sits on top of the circle and becomes illegible. The badge is dumped in the bottom-left corner and the small shoe floats with no connection to anything.
